summary: IceCure Medical Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a Notice of Meeting, Proxy Statement and Proxy Card for an Annual and Special General Meeting scheduled for November 2, 2026 in Caesarea, Israel, with a record date of October 5, 2026. The agenda covers routine matters: reappointing Deloitte-network auditor Brightman Almagor Zohar, re-electing Class I director Yang Huang for a three-year term, and approving equity compensation for CEO Eyal Shamir. The board recommends FOR all proposals. This corresponds to a US annual-meeting proxy circular; no special-situation transaction, stake, price or premium is disclosed, so the filing is routine with no risk-arb angle.
